science_certification: unchanged; no science gate or astrophysical redshift-depth claim
decision: Reuse c128 pilots for optimizer/response/flux engineering checks and matched native Drizzle. Negative extrema remain diagnostic only. A primary discovery false-alarm/recovery comparison requires signed native heldout point-amplitude measurements and real split-half/jackknife null controls; do not choose a winner or claim FPR from positivity-constrained reconstructed maps.

input_contract.native_status: Documented registered detector SCI/ERR/DQ with updated WCS. TweakRegStep.call followed by model.save; alignment script contains no resampling stage. This is source/document evidence, not a completed data-array equality audit.
provenance_audit: Resolve each aligned file to its source CRF through the recorded alignment source/corrected map, not filename guessing.

Where source CRF is available, compare SCI, ERR, DQ and optional VAR_* arrays exactly with equal NaNs; record shape, native dtype, data-array hash, file hash, source hash, and registered WCS/header hash.
Check original and aligned BUNIT, PHOTMJSR, PIXAR_SR and CRDS_CTX. Preserve registered WCS used by the calibration manifest.
Missing originals mean native-data identity audit remains unavailable; do not substitute CAL while keeping aligned-frame calibration.
Do not infer resampling from the directory name aligned.
input_contract.exposure_selection: Expand to an immutable per-band ordered path/hash list and exact count from calibration split identities. Neural command discovers train+validation but optimizer uses only train. Classical reconstruction must use the exact neural train list, not historical PATT3,8 products.
input_contract.output_units: MJy/sr; flux sums use actual WCS pixel solid angles times 1e6 to obtain Jy.
input_contract.target128_hash: Resolve full SHA256 from r5 launch freeze; parent reports prefix 103f2fe4.
input_contract.target_shape_rule: target-header-path NAXIS1/2 must equal crop-size. Never use the 512 target as a 128 target.
input_contract.spatial_selection: Header/coverage only, independent of apparent source brightness. Additional tiles selected deterministically from WCS/coverage and frozen before evaluating detector pixels.
input_contract.manifest_reference128: {output}/detector-screen/manifest-reference128.fits; exact target128 WCS with EXTNAME=SCI so manifest CLI _sci_header can read it.

runnable_scope_and_gaps.commands: Argv templates use existing CLI flags or self-contained Python consumer snippets calling existing APIs. The bootstrap expands {source}/{output}; the plan expander must resolve remaining braces and fail on unresolved tokens. The driver requires the installed optional official Drizzle dependency; it fails rather than substituting another method.
immediate: Existing joint CLI runs the neural paired blank/injection fits with frozen operators and produces per-band heldout native-detector scores.
Existing stacker CLI runs official Drizzle from the same registered detector files, target header and explicit training exposure list.
Existing manifest, effective-PSF and detection CLIs run independently of score_field_models fixed batch names.
The parent's negative-catalog extension must be included in a new hashed source snapshot before using negative peak thresholds.
primary_comparison_prerequisites: The opt-in --native-training-view-dir export now supplies per-TRAIN fixed-background-corrected native SCI, restored ERR^-2 WHT, exact neural valid mask and ImageObservation descriptors. Original registered WCS is unchanged and calibration/injection/source/output hashes are recorded. Existing default coadds remain unchanged.

Use one arm native training-view manifest for official Drizzle after verifying all arms share its mask/WHT/SCI identity for the same batch and frozen calibration. Exported views include the Gaussian/MSE treatment of retained isolated JUMP_DET at original ERR weight; learned noise/crossfit weighting is rejected.

Do not produce the bridge by altering calibration-manifest paths and ignoring hash failures. Use an in-memory adapter or a separate verified view manifest mapping original calibration identity to corrected view identity. Originals remain immutable.

Unmodified stacker argv remains diagnostic. The descriptor-consumer argv below calls the existing official Drizzle helper on verified native view inputs and is the matched primary reconstruction route.

Product staging and response matching are analysis preparation, not covered by existing CLI flags. Stage explicit science/weight products with provenance and common target WCS; for a simple fair detector use the SAME binary common-support map as unit weight for every method. This supplies a uniform matched-response statistic, not an inverse-covariance optimal detector.

Independent response-based smoothing must precede primary matched-resolution detection. It must be flux-normalized convolution without sharpening; if a method cannot reach the frozen Drizzle response target without deconvolution, report resolution failure rather than an eligible matched-resolution depth result.

method_matrix.reconstruction: official compiled Drizzle; square kernel; pixfrac 0.8; surface brightness; same train exposures/mask/background/target

method_matrix.activation: Only if PCG gives useful finite gains. Freeze N_ADAM_BUDGET from blank-only runtime profiling to approximately match median total PCG wall time, then rerun all evaluation batches at that frozen integer. The two original pilot arms are equal Adam steps, not equal compute.

minimal_c128_schedule.reuse: r5 Adam120 and Adam120+PCG3 blank artifacts only if their target/input/calibration/source identities match this freeze.
minimal_c128_schedule.common_support: Intersect blank method geometry and valid masks for F150W/F277W. Freeze once, 9-pixel erosion, 99% 19x19 footprint support, before injection placement. Do not tighten support per method or per positive batch.

batches.purpose: Independent bright engineering response and flux calibration; not a detection threshold/winner selection set.
Paired evaluation, two sources per magnitude.
Second distinct placement, same real noise. Pooled count only four per magnitude, not precise m50.
Signed response/ringing stress control. Negative injections are not noise-only null realizations.

minimal_c128_schedule.fits: Two neural arms times four new batches = eight joint jobs. Classical = two bands times blank plus four new batches = ten cheap stack jobs. Skip negative-injection fits initially if PCG/response already fails; report the control as unevaluated.
stopping: No unchanged-objective or finite-gradient failures; preserve explicit failed methods and exit nonzero.

Check train objective and independently report _validation_detector_scores on PATT3,8 for each band: gaussian_nll_per_pixel, chi2_per_pixel, valid pixels, exposure rows and spatial heldout checks if enabled. ERR-based Gaussian likelihood is a diagonal-noise diagnostic, not discovery significance.
Reject a claimed optimizer gain that lowers train loss while materially worsening heldout detector prediction.
Report original and matched signed response and flux, with failed match explicit. Do not pick the winner by faint-injection recovery.
The c128 result establishes engineering behavior only; do not claim a low survey false-positive rate from its tiny null area.

Positive softplus floors invalidate a symmetric-map-noise assumption. Negative catalogs are diagnostics; a primary discovery/FPR claim remains unavailable until signed heldout native candidate scoring and real null controls are implemented and validated.

null_threshold_contract.statistic: Per-band Z_b=(matched_response_b-center_b)/scale_b; Q_plus=sqrt(sum_b max(Z_b,0)^2); Q_minus=sqrt(sum_b max(-Z_b,0)^2). Centers/scales are frozen from uninjected calibration-region products. Q is a positive combined detection statistic, not Gaussian sigma and not generally a chi variate.
null_threshold_contract.null_proxy: Negative catalog uses the same signed responses, support, whitening and NMS as positive catalog. It is an empirical noise-tail proxy conditional on sign symmetry. Negative ringing, background errors, covariance and source confusion can violate that assumption. Never call negative detections confirmed false positives.
null_threshold_contract.split: For c128 exploratory thresholding, predeclare x<64 as null-calibration and x>=64 as null-evaluation, with a 12-pixel guard on each side of the dividing line removed from both support sets. Geometry is fixed before inspecting statistics. Only recovery sources whose complete measurement footprint lies in the evaluation region enter recovery at the locked threshold; report remaining counts. For c512 use x<256 vs x>=256 with the same guard; additional disjoint tiles can improve area.
null_threshold_contract.threshold_rule: On the uninjected calibration region for each method after response matching, enumerate negative maxima down to diagnostic floor Q=0.1. Let A_cal be summed valid WCS pixel solid angle in arcmin^2, k=floor(20*A_cal). Choose the smallest threshold strictly above the (k+1)-th descending negative peak score, so at most k calibration negative peaks survive; for k=0 use nextafter(max_score,+infinity). If fewer than k+1 peaks exist above 0.1, report the threshold as left-censored/unresolved and do not extrapolate below the floor. Freeze threshold and whitening hashes before positive evaluation. Tie handling must be strict and deterministic.
evaluation: Report independent evaluation negative count/A_eval at the frozen threshold, positive candidate count/A_eval, actual support area, calibrated peak count, threshold uncertainty and the explicit sign-symmetry assumption.
Use non-overlapping spatial blocks for uncertainty. Repeated injection seeds share the same detector noise and do not add null sky area or independent statistical replicates.

At c128 k will often be zero. That forces a threshold above the largest calibration negative peak and is an empirical finite-area screen, not evidence that the underlying false-alarm rate is zero or below target.
Report Poisson count intervals only as an independence approximation; correlation/ringing make block uncertainty preferable when enough distinct blocks exist.

As a scale example only, .063 arcsec pixels imply full c128 area .01806 arcmin^2 and c512 area .28901 arcmin^2 before masks/guards. With zero events the independent-Poisson one-sided 95% bound is -log(.05)/A, about 166/arcmin^2 and 10.4/arcmin^2 respectively. Actual area comes from WCS and masks. Neither single crop resolves 1/arcmin^2; approximately 3 arcmin^2 of independent usable null area is needed even for the zero-count Poisson bound.
null_threshold_contract.selection: Negative-tail thresholds and density plots are diagnostics only. Do not select INR architecture/checkpoints by negative-tail suppression. Freeze training settings, resolution target and all band/subset trials before independent heldout candidate scoring. PATT6,9 remain sealed.
null_threshold_contract.current_scoring: Do not use score_field_models._select as the primary result: it selects maximum m50 using injected validation labels at target purity, hardcodes three batches, and its resolution gate checks only positive-lobe second moments against one reference. Keep its legacy output explicitly diagnostic if run.
null_threshold_contract.role: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Neural softplus plus 1e-4 floors can suppress negative tails while leaving positive noise peaks. Therefore its sign-symmetry proxy is not a primary cross-method false-positive calibration, even after mesh subtraction.

response_and_flux_contract.response: Measure positive-minus-blank signed response at known engineering injection positions. Preserve each raw stamp, injection flux, integrated response, peak, centroid, negative mass fraction and brightness. Do not only normalize and median-stack positive lobes.
response_and_flux_contract.reference: Official Drizzle response per band from response-000 is the explicit classical reference; never use an older blurrier Adam grid as resolution-reference-method.
response_and_flux_contract.matching: Freeze a target response from independent response-000 Drizzle, optionally with predeclared Gaussian sigma 0.25 target pixels. Use flux-preserving nonnegative smoothing kernels only. Log target/kernel hashes and match residuals; if neural response is broader or signed artifacts prevent a stable match, report ineligible matched-resolution recovery rather than smoothing Drizzle arbitrarily to rescue it.
metrics: Signed encircled-energy curves and aperture corrections at fixed radii; actual core/half-energy width; anisotropy and centroid shifts.

MTF/transfer magnitude and phase over declared supported frequencies; ringing/negative mass and response residual norm. Positive Gaussian-equivalent second-moment FWHM is an auxiliary statistic, not full resolution matching.
Response variation across quadrants/positions and source brightness. Four bright sources support only a small spatial screen, not a global PSF model.
Measure all injected-source fluxes at predeclared positions, including undetected sources, to avoid detection-conditioned/Eddington bias.

Paired incremental aperture flux in Jy divided by true per-band manifest flux. Repeat larger 19x19 and 31x31 footprints where geometry permits; report signed wing flux and sensitivity to border background subtraction. Finite aperture flux recovery is not global flux conservation.

Empirical flux-response SNR may be F_response divided by an independently estimated blank forced-aperture flux NMAD in Jy with identical template/support; label this robust empirical response-to-noise ratio. A standardized matched response or Q threshold of 5 is not a Gaussian five-sigma detection.
response_and_flux_contract.injection_model: Current injections use Gaussian engineering PSF contracts, while fitted native PSFs may differ. Same injection in every method is a fair engineering comparison but is not independent physical PSF truth. Record contract mismatch; later add independent real-PSF or perturbed-PSF controls before astrophysical generalization.
response_and_flux_contract.zero_flux_bands: Report absolute leakage aperture flux Jy, signed RMS, and upper-limit behavior; fractional flux bias and effective PSF are undefined when true band flux is zero.

c512_and_dropout_followup.c512: Reuse the exact prescribed 512 north-up target and same frozen per-band input/calibration selection. First run blank and response-000 for all arms. Run recovery batches only if response matching and heldout native-detector checks pass. Use 28 sources per batch, min separation 24px; at least two independent placement batches remain a coarse screen. Broaden disjoint header-selected coverage across both modules before a low-FPR cluster-wide claim.
c512_and_dropout_followup.dropout_minimal: After the two-band continuum optimizer screen, fit red-only F277W with the same neural arms and training patterns; keep F150W out of every red INR fit, loss, early stopping and model choice. Build a separate frozen F150W Drizzle veto product from training patterns. Generate F150W/F277W manifests with dropout_below_angstrom=20000, so F150W truth is zero and F277W is positive. Use F277W for discovery; inspect blue forced flux only after red settings are frozen.
c512_and_dropout_followup.dropout_veto: Freeze an explicit blue-veto rule and apply it identically to positive and negative red candidates. Threshold calibration must account for the same veto/selection. This requires paired red+blue signed catalog/forced measurements; the current multiband positive-Q CLI alone does not implement a blue-veto dropout detector. Do not leak PATT6,9 or heldout blue pixels into training.
c512_and_dropout_followup.six_band_later: For broader coverage freeze red F277W/F356W/F444W discovery and F090W/F150W/F200W blue checks separately; engineering cutoff25000 zeros the three blue bands. Do not call the central-band step rule a physical IGM/high-z model. Current six-band continuum fitting is a different estimator from red-only dropout discovery and must be reported separately. Require per-band heldout NLL/chi2 because pooled scores can be dominated by 36 short-band versus9 long-band exposures and bright blue flux. Preserve current objective/band weighting explicitly; strengthen latent architecture and fit budget using independent training/heldout engineering evidence, not negative-tail or injection winner selection.
c512_and_dropout_followup.magnitudes: The manifest continuum pivot is F200W if present, otherwise the first listed band. Reference_ab_magnitude is not necessarily the detected red-band magnitude, especially when the pivot band is suppressed. Report each band flux Jy and derived AB magnitude directly, plus the declared reference pivot.

command_expansion.source_and_output: Recorded content-hashed bootstrap source and run root; parent runtime expands {source}/{output}.
command_expansion.blank_rule: For blank omit --injection-manifest and reuse verified r5 neural artifacts. For every nonblank append the two-element injection_suffix argv.
command_expansion.c512_rule: Replace --crop-size/--cutout-size 128 with512, target128 with exact target512, sources14 with28 for recovery, min separation16 with24, and spatial threshold partitions as declared. Do not silently change other settings. The manifest-reference preparer assertion128 must also change to512, with a distinct file path; its target input must be the512 target. This is a new freeze, never overwrite the128 reference.
command_expansion.dropout_rule: For red-only neural set --bands F277W. Manifest remains --updec-bands F150W,F277W and append dropout_suffix. Classical blue uses --band F150W. Current detection command is red-only F277W until the separate frozen blue-veto analysis is available.

prepare_manifest_reference: import pathlib,sys,torchsky; a,h=torchsky.read(sys.argv[1],return_header=True); h=dict(h); h["EXTNAME"]="SCI"; out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]); out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); torchsky.write(str(out),a,header=h,overwrite=False); assert torchsky.get_header(str(out),"SCI")["NAXIS1"]==128
matched_official_drizzle_from_native_vie:
import hashlib,importlib.metadata,json,pathlib,sys,time
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])/"src"),str(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])/"benchmarks")]
import torch,torchsky
from torchsky.map import ImageObservation
from bench_map_smacs0723_reproduce import _coadd_with_drizzle
manifest_path=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]); manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
assert manifest["profile"]=="smacs-native-training-view" and manifest["resampled"] is False
rows=[row for row in manifest["rows"] if row["band"]==sys.argv[3]]
assert rows and all(row["split"]=="train" for row in rows)
sha=lambda path: hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for row in rows:
 assert sha(row["source_path"])==row["source_sha256"]
 descriptor=row["image_observation"]
 for kind,key in (("sci","path"),("wht","weight_path"),("mask","mask_path")):
  assert sha(descriptor[key])==row["file_sha256"][kind]
for key in ("manifest","fit_report","injection_manifest"):
 if manifest["calibration"].get(key) is not None:
  assert sha(manifest["calibration"][key])==manifest["calibration"][key+"_sha256"]
_,header=torchsky.read(sys.argv[4],return_header=True); header=dict(header)
start=time.perf_counter()
image,weight=_coadd_with_drizzle([ImageObservation(**row["image_observation"]) for row in rows],target_header=header,kernel="square",pixfrac=.8,value_semantics="surface_brightness")
elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
out=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[5]); out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
paths={}
for key,array,unit in (("sci",image,"MJy/sr"),("wht",weight,"(MJy/sr)^-2")):
 h=dict(header); h["BUNIT"]=unit; path=out/("drizzle_square_pf0p800_"+key+".fits")
 torchsky.write(str(path),torch.from_numpy(array),header=h,overwrite=False); paths[key]={"path":str(path),"sha256":sha(path)}
report={"profile":"smacs-matched-native-drizzle","depth_claim":False,"band":sys.argv[3],"input_manifest":str(manifest_path),"input_manifest_sha256":sha(manifest_path),"target_header_sha256":sha(sys.argv[4]),"kernel":"square","pixfrac":.8,"value_semantics":"surface_brightness","native_train_exposure_ids":[row["exposure_id"] for row in rows],"train_count":len(rows),"elapsed_seconds":elapsed,"drizzle_version":importlib.metadata.version("drizzle"),"products":paths,"weight_semantics":"Drizzle accumulated weight, not a full reconstruction covariance"}
(out/"drizzle.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")

analysis_preparation_contract: Manifest support input is already the final common support; erosion0 avoids re-eroding. Placement at generation remains fully supported; score only predeclared evaluation-region sources with complete footprint.

Stage each method as staged/BATCH/BAND/products/METHOD_sci.fits and METHOD_wht.fits, and response/matched/BAND_METHOD_effective_psf.fits. Validate shape, full target-header identity, units and finite positive supported weights. METHOD identifiers are arm names, not psf_mode/model aliases.

Use common unit weight maps for every primary staged method unless a genuinely comparable propagated covariance contract is implemented. Binary neural support must not be described as inverse variance.

Existing detection profile fits a median mesh background separately for every image. Freeze its block64/stride32/filter/self-mask settings; report that injection can perturb this nonlinear estimator. For an exact paired response detector, a future option must freeze the blank background map for positive images; do not assume current CLI does this.

Build negative-tail thresholds from blank calibration catalogs only and save input hashes, floor, target density, support area, scores, selected threshold and tie policy. Existing classical-validation target-purity calibration must not be substituted.

Recovery uses one-to-one maximum-cardinality matching within2 target pixels and reports source/per-band truth counts, matched counts, uncertainty and spurious incremental peaks after a common paired blank union exclusion6pixels. This is injection recovery conditional on the exclusion/selection, not purity of undiscovered real sources.

Do not use avoidance-catalogue to score or tune faint unknown sources. If a paired blank union is used to separate existing sky from incremental injected detections, freeze it across methods and report excluded sources/area and the resulting conditional population.

UPdec iter0/iter10 static products may be reported only as contextual response/appearance diagnostics. No executable in the inspected tree reruns published UPdec on the same injected detector exposures; a matched UPdec primary needs its separately frozen native pipeline argv and calibration contract.

The matched_official_drizzle_from_native_view consumer verifies source, calibration, injection and exported file hashes before using existing official Drizzle. Append native_training_view_suffix to one neural arm for each batch; export once per exact train/calibration/injection identity and reuse for all comparator arms. Do not inject again in Drizzle: exported positive views already contain the injection.
required_result_table: train objective convention and final loss
heldout native Gaussian NLL and chi2 per band
total runtime and peak GPU allocation
positive recovery by actual per-band AB/flux with counts
interpretation: The immediate runs establish optimizer, signed response and all-source flux engineering behavior on real detector pixels. Negative-map extrema are a descriptive sign-symmetry diagnostic only; positive INR floors prevent them from serving as primary cross-method false-positive calibration. A later passing signed heldout/jackknife analysis supports a conditional empirical native-detector discovery test, not physical redshift depth, astrophysical truth, Gaussian map-Q SNR, science certification, or a model chosen on those injections.
verification: JSON parse; CLI-flag AST audit; actual merged SIREN constructor and forward evaluation; SCI-primary EXTNAME reference read check; native training-view software test. Matching kernels, empirical candidate scorer, null calibration and real Drizzle runtime remain separate work.

primary_discovery_contract.status: Requires focused native candidate-amplitude analysis; no inspected current CLI implements candidate SNR or this null calibration. Existing detector scoring reports whole-image native NLL/chi2 only.
primary_discovery_contract.discovery: Freeze candidate coordinates from TRAIN reconstruction, common signed-response matching and detector recipe; no re-centering, threshold/model tuning or blue-band use on heldout science pixels. Include candidate selections from every compared method so coverage does not depend on one favored reconstruction.
primary_discovery_contract.heldout: Use only PATT3,8 native detector pixels for initial confirmation diagnostics, per band, with frozen registered WCS/PSF/calibration and excluded calibration footprints. At each frozen position fit a signed free point-source amplitude in Jy and predeclared local constant/linear-background nuisance by deterministic weighted least squares. Fix native-pixel patches and PSF templates before looking at amplitudes. Do not impose softplus/nonnegative amplitude; do not use training-INR flux as an input label. Report fit residuals and crowding/model mismatch.
primary_discovery_contract.nominal_statistic: For nuisance design C, weight W and native unit-flux point template t, profile residuals with P_W=I-C(C^T W C)^-1 C^T W; information=t^T W P_W t, signed amplitude=(t^T W P_W y)/information, nominal sigma=information^-1/2. Whitened QR or least squares avoids explicit ill-conditioned projector inverses. Require full rank, positive information, and consistent Jy template normalization. Per-band amplitude/sigma is nominal pipeline-ERR significance until empirical noise calibration.
primary_discovery_contract.real_noise_controls: Predeclare geometry-selected trial positions independently of candidate pixels. Estimate signed amplitudes separately on validation pattern halves3 and8 with their own native PSF/ERR/backgrounds. Sky-canceling delta F=F3-F8 and nominal variance sigma3^2+sigma8^2 supply real-detector jackknife noise controls even when a trial position contains a real source, provided forward-model response is matched. Also inspect matched half reconstructions; reconstruction differences alone are conditional engineering diagnostics for nonlinear INR.
primary_discovery_contract.limits: Difference-noise and combined-flux noise distributions are equivalent only under appropriate sign symmetry/exchangeability/weight matching; PSF/background/morphology errors can spoil sky cancellation. Check both signs, position/flux dependence, detector-pattern dependence and residual correlation. Treat empirical null exceedance as conditional on these checks, not a validated astrophysical false-source fraction.
primary_discovery_contract.threshold: Freeze primary thresholds using signed native jackknife/null-control amplitudes, independently of injected recovery labels. Calibrate the COMPLETE selection statistic including positive-amplitude requirement, all searched positions, any max over red subsets and the blue-veto rule. Report null trial count, effective independent blocks and finite-area bounds. Existing negative-catalog vectors remain descriptive diagnostics.
primary_discovery_contract.snr: Report per-band signed heldout amplitude Jy, nominal ERR sigma Jy, jackknife empirical scale/quantile, selected statistic and explicit trial correction. Do not label map Q or positive-INR noise compression a Gaussian discovery SNR.
primary_discovery_contract.recovery: Use new heldout/injection evaluation placements only after detector/threshold freeze, with training candidates scored by heldout native photons. Report counts and confidence limits rather than an unsupported m50 fit; data/model selection on engineering injections does not certify real-source or high-z discovery.
primary_discovery_contract.red_blue: Primary red-only F277W/F356W/F444W discovery statistic is distinct from all-six-band positive-Q, which adds positive blue noise for true dropouts. Any max over subsets must be included in empirical null/trial calibration. Blue data stay outside red training/model choice and enter only a frozen confirmation/veto protocol.
